notes: ἐν τῇ σήμερον ἡμέρᾳ: 'this' is given to σήμερον and the article left unrepresented so that no content word goes empty; the rule 60 alternative (article to 'this') is named in the article's note.
ἐν is unrepresented under rule 36, the ASV writing no preposition word; πάντων takes 'of all men' headed on 'all' under rule 17.
